name: headroom-0370
install_doc: Installs the competitor release a user actually gets today, into its own uv tool directory under the binary name headroom037, by bench/thol/Dockerfile.headroom037. This is the arm any cost comparison should use: comparing against an older pinned build measures work they have already superseded and tells us nothing about the product a user would install.
notes: Runs their own entry point and primary mode -- `headroom wrap claude` starts their proxy and sets ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL so all API traffic is compacted with no agent opt-in, which is their strongest configuration rather than a default we chose for them.
